topic: GetConfig and ListSettings are still unfiltered for agent callers (rest of RC-700)
detail: SP-026 filters every RPC RC-700 named except GetConfig (orch's settings) and ListSettings (managed harness settings), which sessions may still call under a policy. Settings can name folders, collections and profile directories of every space. Proposed: under a policy refuse both to all but Orch.app (refuseNonOperator, as SP-078 did for the setters) or return only keys that name no space; SP-078's owner should decide, since it changed the setters.
